name: Gainsight (Customer Communities)
description: The Gainsight Community MCP connects your Customer Community to Claude. Surface unanswered questions, identify content gaps, and pull engagement trends through natural language. Review moderation queues, browse leaderboards, and audit community structure without waiting on a custom export. Purpose-built for community managers who'd rather ask their AI than navigate multiple dashboards.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Gainsight (Customer Communities) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Gainsight (Customer Communities) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.insided.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Gainsight (Customer Communities) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gainsight (Customer Communities) lists 13 MCP tools, including admin_community_structure, admin_moderation_overview, admin_recognition_overview, admin_user_overview, analytics_audience, analytics_community_health, analytics_content_performance, analytics_individual_user_profile, analytics_product_ideas, analytics_user_trends, search_analytics, and search_discussions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Gainsight (Customer Communities)?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Gainsight (Customer Communities) in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, ClearFeed, Conduit, and DevRev.

_published_faq.name: Does Gainsight (Customer Communities) MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gainsight (Customer Communities) requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Gainsight (Customer Communities) is developed by Gainsight. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
